scientific_integrity: Closed analytic proof with independently executed numerical and algebraic cross-checks; no independent scientific audit or priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Stationary second moments only; independent Brownian force excursions, independent strictly positive reset intervals with finite second moment, fixed mean, harmonic particle not itself reset. The Brownian renewal covariance and its convex-order Jensen consequences are prior/general tools, not claimed as new. The assessed result is the exact strictly monotone Poisson/periodic variance penalty and its sharp factors 6 and 2. Publication priority and broader existing implications remain uncertain.
title: Sharp Poisson-to-periodic variance penalty for Brownian reset forcing in a harmonic trap
